title: anaphalis keriensis
intro: Anaphalis keriensis, commonly known as Keri Anaphalis or Tibetan snow lotus, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is native to the high-altitude regions of the Himalayas and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Anaphalis keriensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-bacterial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antimicrobial effects.
